clm:recon-retry-limit@2025: We cut retries from 5 to 3 after INC-2291. AcmeBank's idempotency key only lasts 15 minutes. With exponential backoff, retries 4 and 5 fired after the window, so the bank treated them as new payouts and 14 merchants were paid twice. Three retries keep total backoff around 7 minutes, safely inside the window. Don't raise it without checking the bank's window first.
